address: Anas Ibn Malik Road, Alyasmin, Riyadh, 13325, Saudi Arabia
bio: It’s all about celebrating Najdi culture here. From the off, the charming team will meet you at the door and guide you upstairs to a super chic restaurant. Take your pick of formally laid table, majlis-style seating or on the floor. The traditionally dressed team offer dates and Saudi coffee before you start your meal. Classic Najdi cuisine is full of flavour; go for the chicken mubahar rice flavoured with their special spices. Should you have room for dessert, get the tasty mini cheese and honey sambosa. A word to the wise: book ahead.
